The Queenstown Single Member Constituency is a single member constituency (SMC) in Singapore. It is managed by Tanjong Pagar Town Council. The current Member of Parliament (MP) for the constituency is Eric Chua from the governing People's Action Party (PAP).
History
Prior to the 2025 general election, Queenstown SMC was carved out from Tanjong Pagar Group Representation Constituency (GRC), which it had belonged to as a division.
Chua, the incumbent MP for the Queenstown division in Tanjong Pagar GRC, stood for reelection in the SMC. He defeated Mahaboob Batcha from the People's Alliance for Reform (PAR) with 81.12% of the vote.
